stemMd: A fair die is rolled twice. What is the probability that the sum is 9?
explanationMd: There are thirty-six equally likely ordered pairs. A sum of nine comes from (3,6), (4,5), (5,4) and (6,3), four pairs. Thus probability is 4/36=1/9.

distractorRationale.d: The six possible first rolls do not each have a matching second roll.
distractorRationale.b: This counts only three favourable ordered pairs.
distractorRationale.e: This double-counts the four favourable ordered pairs.
